intro: The power died an hour ago. Somebody wanted you in the dark. Find a way out.
ending: Cold air rushes in. Beyond the door the city glitters under a wet night sky, and for the first time tonight you can see where you're going.

rooms.name: Electrical Room
rooms.description: A lone lamp swings overhead. Beyond its light, the walls hum.

items.name: flashbulb
items.floor_text: A flashbulb lies in the light.
items.inspect: A press flashbulb with one shot left. Not yours: somebody took pictures in here tonight. One flash would show what the lamp can't.
items.refusal: You've got one flash. Save it for somewhere the lamp can't reach.

containers.name: toolbox
containers.closed_text: A toolbox waits on the floor.
containers.inspect: Your own toolbox, dented and familiar. Somebody went through it tonight and put everything back, almost right.

contents.name: screwdriver
contents.inspect: A worn flathead. The tip is just the width of the screws on the fuse box.

contents.name: wrench
contents.inspect: Heavy and rusted, the jaws set wide. Too big for anything in here but the bolts on the vent.

containers.name: fuse box
containers.closed_text: A fuse box is screwed shut.

room_text.power on: The fuse box hums; a red light glows by the door.

inspect.closed: Grey steel, four flathead screws. Fresh scratches round every one. Somebody had this open tonight.
inspect.open: A neat row of fuses with one empty socket. Nothing blew in here. That fuse was pulled out by hand.
inspect.power on: Every socket full. The box hums, and over by the door a small red light is awake.

uses.refusal: The fuse box is screwed shut.
uses.text: You press the fuse home. The box hums, the lamp steadies, and by the door a small red light wakes up.

contents.name: key
contents.inspect: Small and brass, on a paper tag. In a woman's hand: "For when you wake up. V."

room_text.closed: A vent sits low in the dark.
room_text.open: The vent hangs open, black inside.
room_text.flashed: The vent hangs open, its duct gone dark again.

inspect.closed: A low grille held by four rusted bolts. The dust on the bolt heads has been wiped clean.
inspect.open: The duct runs back into pitch black. The lamp can't reach in there. You'd need a flash to see.
inspect.flashed: The flash burned the duct onto your eyes: dust, and a clean track where something was pushed in tonight.

uses.refusal: The grille is bolted shut. Get it open first.
uses.text: The bulb pops. For an instant the duct is white as noon, and just inside lies a fuse wrapped in silk.

contents.name: fuse
contents.inspect: A good glass fuse, wrapped in a silk handkerchief with a V stitched in the corner. Pulled, not blown.

door.refusal: The key won't turn. The electric bolt holds it, dead as the lights.
door.unlock_text: The key turns. With a hum, the electric bolt slides back.

room_text.unlocked: The door is unlocked, a green light over its keyhole.
room_text.open: The door stands open on a dark corridor.

inspect.locked: Steel. A brass keyhole under the handle, and above it an electric bolt with a dead light. Without power, no key will move it.
inspect.unlocked: The bolt is drawn back and a green light glows over the keyhole. Nothing holds the door now.
inspect.open: The door stands open. Beyond it a corridor runs off into the dark, smelling of vinegar.

items.name: negatives
items.inspect: Six frames, too small and too dark to read by this light. Somebody shot a whole roll tonight. They want the enlarger.
items.refusal: Negatives are no use like that. They want the enlarger.

inspect: A red safelight in a steel housing, too hot to touch. Its cable runs up behind the box and out of sight.
inspect.searched: The housing ticks as it cools. The hook behind it is empty now.

uses.refusal: Poke around behind a hot lamp? Not without a reason.
uses.text: You reach behind the housing with the tongs. Something on a hook gives, and a small key drops to the floor.

items.name: padlock key
items.floor_text: A small key lies on the floor.
items.inspect: Small and steel, still warm from the lamp. It fits a padlock, and there's only one padlock in here.

containers.name: camera bag
containers.closed_text: A camera bag lies on the floor.
containers.inspect: A press photographer's bag, the strap mended with wire. The same make as that flashbulb.

contents.name: lens
contents.inspect: An enlarging lens, cap still on. Without it the enlarger can only throw a blur.

room_text.focused: The enlarger throws a white square.

inspect.closed: An enlarger on a steel column, its lamp good, its lens mount empty.
inspect.focused: A sharp white square on the easel. All it needs now is something to print.
inspect.printed: The lamp is still on. Whatever was on that roll is in the tray now.

uses.text: You screw the lens home. A sharp white square lands on the easel.

uses.refusal: Without a lens the enlarger would only print a blur.
uses.text: You expose a sheet and slide it into the developer. Under the red light, a picture swims up.

containers.name: tray
containers.closed_text: A tray sits under its lid.

inspect.closed: A shallow tray of developer under a black lid.
inspect.open: Developer, black and still, smelling of vinegar.

contents.name: photograph
contents.inspect: The safelight on this wall, and a gloved hand reaching in behind it. On the white border, in pencil: "behind the light. don't keep me waiting. V."

inspect.closed: Grey steel, the doors held by a hasp and one big rusted bolt. The kind of bolt your wrench was made for.
inspect.open: Shelves of chemicals in brown bottles. Somebody kept this place tidy.

contents.name: tongs
contents.inspect: Bamboo tongs, the tips stained brown. Long enough to reach where fingers shouldn't go.

door.unlock_text: The padlock springs open and drops off the bolt.

inspect.locked: A light-tight door, a bolt across it and a padlock through the bolt. Fresh oil on the shackle.
inspect.unlocked: The padlock hangs open. Nothing holds the bolt now.
inspect.open: The door stands open on a flight of stairs going up.

inspect: Cast iron, too hot to touch. Something has slipped down behind it, out of reach of fingers.
inspect.searched: Cast iron, ticking. Nothing behind it now but dust.

uses.text: You fish behind the hot radiator. The tongs come back scorched, holding a matchbook.

items.name: matchbook
items.inspect: From the Blue Lantern club. Inside the flap, in pencil: "the lamp in his office. light it, and look where the light falls. then go. don't wait for me. V."
items.refusal: Not that. Somewhere in here wants lighting.

items.name: shutter key
items.floor_text: A key hangs on a nail.
items.inspect: Heavy, on a red tag: STREET DOOR. It hung in the dark where only the lantern could find it.

containers.name: coat
containers.closed_text: A coat hangs on a stand.

inspect.closed: The night watchman's coat, still damp at the shoulders. Its pockets sag with something.
inspect.open: Empty pockets and the smell of rain. He left in a hurry, or somebody hurried him.

contents.name: desk key
contents.inspect: A small brass key, the kind that fits a desk drawer.

inspect.closed: The watchman's desk, the drawer locked. A logbook on top, the last entry torn out.
inspect.open: Pencils, a ruler, a cold cup of coffee. And nothing else to stop a nosy guest.

contents.name: letter opener
contents.inspect: Thin steel with a flat tip. It would pry a cover off as well as open a letter.

inspect.closed: An oil lantern with a good wick and nothing to light it with.
inspect.lit: A steady yellow flame. The corners of the room have come out of the dark.

uses.text: The wick takes. Warm light climbs the walls, and by the coat stand something glints: a key on a nail.

inspect.closed: A red light, blinking. A thin seam runs round the cover where a blade might go.
inspect.open: Wires and a battery, prised loose. The red light is dead.

door.refusal: The key turns halfway and stops. Over the desk the alarm panel blinks: cut it first, or the whole street wakes.
door.unlock_text: The key turns all the way. The bolt slides back.

inspect.locked: Steel, with a pane of wired glass. Neon on the wet street outside. The lock wants a heavy key.
inspect.unlocked: The bolt is back. One push and you're out.
inspect.open: The door stands open on a wet, glittering night.
